description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the DateTimeHelperService within the OrangeHRM project. It includes multiple test methods that verify date formatting, date comparison, date range calculations, timezone handling, and week boundary calculations, specifically for the DateTimeHelperService class.

classes.name: DateTimeHelperServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing various functionalities of the DateTimeHelperService class, including date formatting, comparison, range calculation, timezone determination, and week boundary calculation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DateTimeHelperService instance before each test.

methods.name: testFormatDateTimeToYmd
methods.description: Tests the formatting of DateTime objects to 'Y-m-d' string format, including timezone conversions and handling null inputs.

methods.name: testFormatDateTimeToTimeString
methods.description: Tests the extraction of time portion from DateTime objects as string, with timezone conversions and null inputs.

methods.name: testIsDatesEqual
methods.description: Verifies equality comparison between DateTime objects across different timezones, including null comparisons and date differences.

methods.name: testDateDiffInHours
methods.description: Tests the calculation of hour differences between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: testDateRange
methods.description: Validates the generation of date ranges between two dates, with optional interval parameter, including single-day ranges.

methods.name: assertDateArray
methods.description: Helper function to compare expected date string array with actual DateTime array.

methods.name: testGetNow
methods.description: Checks that the service's current DateTime instance has the same timezone and offset as the system DateTime.

methods.name: testGetTimezoneByTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Validates that offsets produce correct DateTimeZone objects.

methods.name: testGetWeekBoundaryForGivenDate
methods.description: Tests the computation of week start and end dates for various days of the week and different starting weekdays.
